{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash

# Flux batch script
#
# This is a self-submitting Flux script: run it directly (e.g., `./nightly.flux.sh`).
# It will submit itself to Flux with the translated resource requests.

# Translated resources from Slurm:
#   -N 1             -> -N 1
#   --time=8:00:00   -> -t 8h
#   --output=log-gcc.out -> -o output=log-gcc.out
JOBID=$(flux batch -N 1 -n 1 -t 8h -o output=log-gcc.out --wrap "bash $0 __flux_inner")

echo "Submitted Flux job: $JOBID"

if [ "${1:-}" = "__flux_inner" ]; then
  # NOTE: Slurm partition line is commented out (##SBATCH -p c60-m0); no translation performed.

  # NOTE: This script references Slurm environment variables (SLURM_STEP_ID, SLURM_PROCID, SLURM_JOB_ID).
  # Flux does not set these. Performance implication: none; operational implication: the informational print
  # about the job id will not work unless adapted.

  # Emit a similar message under Flux (best-effort):
  if [ -n "${FLUX_JOB_ID:-}" ]; then
    echo "print FLUX_JOB_ID = ${FLUX_JOB_ID}"
  fi

  cd /home/projects/albany/nightlyCDashTrilinosBlake || exit 1
  source blake_gcc_modules.sh >& gcc_modules.out
  bash nightly_cron_script_trilinos_blake_gcc_release.sh
  bash nightly_cron_script_trilinos_blake_gcc_debug.sh

  cd /home/projects/albany/nightlyCDashAlbanyBlake || exit 1
  bash nightly_cron_script_albany_blake_gcc_release.sh
  bash nightly_cron_script_albany_blake_gcc_debug.sh
  bash nightly_cron_script_albany_blake_gcc_sfad.sh sfad6
  bash nightly_cron_script_albany_blake_gcc_sfad.sh sfad12
  bash nightly_cron_script_albany_blake_gcc_sfad.sh sfad24
  bash nightly_cron_script_mali_blake_gcc_release.sh
fi
"
}
